notes: v3.0.43 - The pull itself now finishes the job: clicking Pull means you are there, so chart reads get the same bring-Athena-forward assist that made the retry heal every stuck history in live testing - the first pass captures everything and the retry button becomes a formality. The assist stays polite: it never acts when you are outside Chrome, and the moment you switch tabs it goes quiet for the rest of that pull. When something still cannot finish, the banner now tells the truth about why: if Athena signed you out (its idle timeout), it says sign in again instead of try again; if the reads only needed your presence, it says exactly that. Everything from v3.0.42 remains. Requires Chrome 116+.
